verdict.rationale: Install is a short one/two-line command (`/plugin marketplace add ...` then `/plugin install superpowers@...`) and skills 'auto-trigger' immediately after install with no extra setup, suggesting a fast path to a working skill (docs-36, docs-51, gh-11). However, installation is harness-specific and must be repeated per tool (gh-5), one community note calls the codex/opencode install mechanism 'curl|bash but with added LLM agents' (comm-4), and no source gives an explicit time-to-working-skill claim or dedicated quickstart walkthrough. Missing for 10: an explicit 'under 5 minutes' quickstart doc, first-run verification steps, and independent confirmation of install speed across harnesses.
